lines.text: Sam is about to buy forty acres.
Sam has the survey. The appraisal. The offer letter.
But not the one number that decides the deal: what the dirt costs.
Marine clay. Shallow rock. A high water table.
One surprise, and a quarter million dollars walks out of the pro forma.
Drop a pin on any parcel.
DirtBid pulls the official U S D A soil survey, and prices the site work line by line. C S I organized. Regionally priced.
Three weeks of due diligence, in under thirty minutes.
Then it hands you a vetted team for every step. Survey, civil, geo-tech, title, financing, all the way to the crew that moves the dirt.
Screen your first parcel free, at dirt bid A I dot com.
No credit card. Just answers, before you sign.
